column1: # The minimal witnesses d27_frame.c runs first (fixed_case, in this order), one
# per finding in REPORT.md. Each is a window site in plain words; the driver
# builds it with the same hooks as the generated population (s, n, lo, miss
# MF_MISS_N, fn_name, table_name; STMT/ASSIGN: result r, result_decl "size_t ",
# on_miss "return 0;", on_miss_leaves 1), portable target, no options.
# Since lane d27fix (2026-11-13) every witness HOLDS; the last column is what broke before.

column3: FUNC/RETURN; one alternative, entry NONE; one span start 0, len 2, verify NO, core [0,2), sets {'q'},{' '}, no offers; art lever run-tie-left
column4: DEFINE ask answers 0 AND sets the art's error ("the run ranking's first position 0 is not the run member"); mf_define on a fresh art refuses with that text

column3: STMT/ASSIGN, site_kind REPORT, empty NOP; span start 0, len 2, verify YES, core all, sets {'a'},{'b'}, offers 1,2
column4: EMIT ask answers 0; mf_emit refuses ("window-search: a NOP ASSIGN cannot declare its result")

column3: as W2 but empty MISS and decl_point 1
column4: EMIT ask answers 0; mf_emit refuses ("mf_use: handle 1 is used before its mf_locals")

column3: STMT/ASSIGN, site_kind REPORT; span start 0, len 3, verify YES, core all, sets {'a'},{'b'},{'c'}, offers 1,2,3; table_name stated
column4: plan_test TABLE at every plan position; the text compares the three bytes as one run (memcmp/word compare) and reads no offered table

column3: FUNC/RETURN; span start 0, len 2, verify YES, core all, sets {'a'},{'b'}
column4: fused FN on E-func; the text defines and calls <fn_name>/<fn_name>__body and never spells <prefix>_mf<handle>_ofsskip (held under the reading in REPORT.md)
